data.description: When moving an event card to the hand it should use an action
data.title: Moving an event card should cost an action

data.author: Map
data.comment:
## Clarifying Questions for Producer

**Q1 — Scope vs CG-0MT5W4V98000EDOO (Executing an event consumes an action):**
There is a separate open item CG-0MT5W4V98000EDOO asking that *playing* an event from hand should also consume an action. Should this item (CG-0MTFWBNL30043ZBM) cover only the **move** operation, or both move AND play? The natural design trajectory (consistent with business-card economy) suggests both, but they're currently separate items. Should they be merged?

**Q2 — Same-day composite semantics:**
For business cards: move-to-hand consumes the action, same-day placement is free (composite). For events, should moving an event and playing it on the same day follow a composite rule (move = 1 action, play = free), or should every play also cost a separate action?

**Q3 — Tutorial rework scope:**
T9 in the tutorial explicitly depends on "Events move to hand FREE (no action)" — this allows the Local Festival buy to share day 2 with the Laundromat placement (T7). If the event move now costs an action, the tutorial day structure must change. Should tutorial rework be in scope for this item?

**Q4 — AI/Monte Carlo scope:**
Both the AI strategy (enumerateLegalActions, scoreEventAction) and Monte Carlo harness enumerate and score buy-event/play-event actions without action budget gating. Should AI/MC updates be in scope?

**Q5 — Coins at play:**
The cost-at-play model (event.cost deducted from coins when played) — should this remain unchanged? Presumably yes, but confirming.
